description:
This is a Pre-solicitation notice. This Pre-solicitation notice is not a request for formal quotes.  Solicitation 36C24626Q0448, will be issued on or about 03/25/2026. The Department of Veterans Affairs, Richmond VAMC, Richmond, VA has a requirement for Medrad Injector Preventative Maintenance Service. This is a 3-year contract.       
Â 
This acquisition is set-aside for Service Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses. The applicable NAICS Code is 811210 with a size standard of $34.0 Million. All correspondence and responses shall be via e-mail to Stephen.Nasssan@va.gov. Telephone requests for information or questions will NOT be accepted.     
Â 
Offerors are responsible for downloading all documents including amendments from Contracting Opportunities at sam.gov website without further notification from the Contracting Officer.
